definitions.c0: extrapolated concentration: mg/g for the three compounds, g/g for TDS
definitions.cup_eq3: integral of fitted exponential, source Eq.3
definitions.cup_mass_units: mg for the three compounds, g for TDS
definitions.scores: Original ±10% V1 criterion, fixed 60 lambda and 180 Eq.3 cup denominators

spec:solubles.kernel_loading_cap.reason: Disabled by the builder for total particle loading: the initial particle concentration is not an equilibrium capacity. Kernel loading follows its source partition law and may exceed its initial value during inward diffusion. This boundary restriction is not selected by fit quality.

model.hydraulics.pore_air_amplitude.reason: The initial effective connectivity deficit is a grade D model assumption (0.5), separate from coffee CO2; it is not a measured gas volume fraction. None of the calibration observables identifies a transient relative-permeability law. It is held at its prior rather than fitted to the held-out V4 first-drop delay or flow rise.

model.hydraulics.pore_air_permeability_e.reason: The effective connectivity-to-relative-permeability exponent is a grade D closure (3), not measured for these pucks. Held fixed; the V4 transient, V3 and V5 shot times do not select it.

model.hydraulics.moisture_diffusivity.reason: The pore-air relaxation time uses (D32/2)^2/(pi^2 D), capped at 600 s, with D = 2.5e-11 m^2/s from the independent Mateus moisture-uptake range. Using moisture diffusion for air clearance is a grade D model assumption. Neither this diffusivity nor its time scale is fitted to held-out shots.

model.hydraulics.wetting_uptake.reason: In M1.1 this is the fixed effective-loading normalization inherited from the extraction model, distinct from the full intraparticle water inventory. It is not fitted to startup observations.

extraction.diffusivity.caffeine.particle.reason: Species kernel diffusivities trade off with the coffee's contents (correlation −0.89 to −0.95): their posterior SD was 2–12× the prior's, and free fits drifted 2–5× outside the literature priors (caffeine to 8×10⁻¹¹, trigonelline to the 1×10⁻⁹ bound). The species surface-pool scales carry the species' λ instead.

model.species.trigonelline.diffusivity_8.reason: Not identified by V1 (see the caffeine diffusivity).

model.species.cqa5.diffusivity_80c.reason: Not identified by V1 (see the caffeine diffusivity).

extraction.surface_rate.grudeva2026.reason: Not identified by V1 (posterior SD 44× the prior's once the lumped diffusivity is fixed); the surface flux is fast at any value in its range, so only the surface pool's size matters.

model.hydraulics.swelling_pore_closure.reason: Not identified by V1 (posterior SD 1.6× the prior's when added at the V1 optimum); the residuals lean towards less swelling (Wald z 2.4 towards 0).

model.hydraulics.gas_amplitude_max.reason: Weakly identified by V1 (posterior SD 0.4–0.7× the prior's) with no evidence against the registry value (Wald z 0.8); the CO₂ model is being re-anchored in the input models.

hydraulics.dissolution_porosity_share.reason: θ is fixed at its mechanistic default, 0 (the insoluble cell walls hold the particle envelope), not chosen by fit quality: it is collinear with the bed permeability, whose fitted values move to absorb it. `calibrate --sensitivity` reports the θ = 0.27 case as a structural sensitivity.

model.species.cqa5.partition.reason: Pruned by the identifiability rule after a bounded registry-value refit: local marginal SD 0.85× the prior's (fitted value 0.6424); training cost stayed within 1% of both the initial pre-prune and current accepted fits.
